source_title: Fox One Will Track 2026 Midterm Election Results With New App Experience
source_excerpt:
The 2026 midterm elections are less than a week away, and Fox has unveiled a new interactive experience for Fox One app subscribers on Election Day, Tuesday, Nov. 3, to keep up with the news and results as they come in across the country.
With hundreds of House, Senate, gubernatorial and local races happening all at once, it can be tough to follow along with every update. According to a statement, Fox One has launched an interface to keep track of everything, “where a race in one state reframes the math in another and where what matters most to viewers may be a ballot measure in their own county.”
The features that’ll appear as part of this rollout include a command center on the Fox One home screen, with widgets that update in real time on things like voter polls, contest results and Fox News “Election Insights” on key races; a curated election hub that’ll include all of Fox’s election coverage; and a new Elections Mode version of Ask Fox, the app’s AI-powered chatbot, where viewers can ask election-based questions and receive answers in real time.
“The results don’t arrive in order, and no two viewers are following the same set of races,” said Amit Dudakia, senior vice president and head of product at Fox Direct to Consumer. “With Fox One, we’re keeping coverage from Fox News and Fox Stations at the center and building the context around it, so viewers aren’t toggling between a stream and a second screen to understand what just happened.”
Fox One’s complete channel portfolio includes Fox News Channel, Fox Nation, Fox Sports, B1G, FS1, FS2, the Fox Network and local Fox stations. It is available at no additional cost for cable and satellite TV customers and is priced at $20 a month for a stand-alone subscription to the app. The new in-app election experience will launch on Election Day.
